metadata.description: Celebrate 80 years of freedom with questions on historic milestones, freedom fighters, the Constitution, and national symbols.

questions.question: At what exact time on August 15, 1947 did Jawaharlal Nehru deliver his historic 'Tryst with Destiny' speech?
questions.explanation: Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru delivered the famous 'Tryst with Destiny' speech to the Indian Constituent Assembly on the eve of India's independence, towards midnight on 14-15 August 1947.

questions.question: Who was affectionately known as the 'Iron Man of India' for unifying over 560 princely states into the Indian Union?
questions.explanation: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, India's first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister, led the historic integration of 565 princely states into the Republic of India.

questions.question: Which revolutionary gave the iconic slogan 'Give me blood, and I shall give you freedom!'?
questions.explanation: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose motivated the Indian National Army (Azad Hind Fauj) with this stirring call during India's struggle for independence.

questions.question: What revolutionary democratic reform did India adopt on Day One that took Western democracies over a century to implement?
options: Universal Adult Suffrage (voting rights for all citizens)
questions.explanation: India granted universal adult voting rights to every citizen on day one regardless of gender, literacy, or property ownership.

questions.question: Who designed the national flag of independent India (the Tricolor with Ashoka Chakra)?
questions.explanation: Pingali Venkayya, an Indian freedom fighter and educationist, designed the original model on which the national flag was based.

questions.question: How many spokes are in the Ashoka Chakra situated in the center of the Indian National Flag?
questions.explanation: The Ashoka Chakra has 24 spokes, symbolizing the 24 hours of the day and 24 virtuous principles of human life and continuous progress.

questions.question: Who was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee and is revered as the Father of the Indian Constitution.

questions.question: In which historic year did Mahatma Gandhi lead the Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha) protesting the British salt tax?
questions.explanation: The 24-day Salt March to Dandi took place from March 12 to April 6, 1930, capturing global attention for the civil disobedience movement.

questions.question: Which patriotic national song was composed by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee in his novel 'Anandamath'?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote 'Vande Mataram' in 1876, which later became the national song of India.

questions.question: Which historic mission made India the first nation in the world to successfully land a spacecraft near the lunar south pole?
questions.explanation: On August 23, 2023, ISRO's Chandrayaan-3 achieved a historic soft landing near the Moon's South Pole, celebrating India's modern scientific leadership.
